name: Intimidating Scold (Metamagic)
body:
You know not only how to be obeyed, but how to be feared too.

Benefit(s): When casting a language-dependent spell or a power word spell on a creature, if you know the full name of that creature, you can add it to the spell’s verbal component.

The spell will affect that creature only (even if it normally can affect more creatures), but if the target fails its save, it is also shaken for a number of rounds equal to the spell’s original level (as Fearsome Spell). If the spell doesn’t allow a save, the target can attempt a Will save (against the same DC the spell would have if it did allow a save) to negate the shaken effect. If the spell effect already causes creatures to become shaken, on a failed save, add the duration of this metamagic effect to the duration of the shaken condition imposed by the spell. An intimidating scold can’t cause a creature to become frightened, even if that creature is already shaken.

An intimidating scold uses up a spell slot 1 level higher than the spell’s actual level.
